
# Load necessary libraries
```{r}
library(haven)
library(readr)  
library(lubridate)
library(Hmisc)
library(survey)
library(gtsummary)
library(srvyr)
library(gt)
library(dplyr)
library(here)
```

# Load the dataset
```{r}
df <-  read_csv(here("final", "Coq_combined.csv"))

df <- df %>%
  filter(edit == 2013)

head(df)
```

#Loop to calculate prevalence by age (all individuals)
```{r}
# Create empty dataframe to store results
results_df <- data.frame(age = numeric(0), serohcv_binary = character(0), proportion = numeric(0), n_poids = numeric(0))

# Loop through each unique, sorted age value
for (x in head(sort(unique(df$age)), -1)) {
# Filter the data frame for the current age
df_new <- df %>%
    filter(age == x)  
# Define the survey design for the filtered data
dfw <- svydesign(id = ~cserv+nqes, strata = ~ville_num, fpc = ~FPC_structure + FPC_UD, weights = ~wc, data = df_new,vce = "linearized",
        nest = TRUE,
        single.unit = "certainty",
        lonely.psu = "adjust")
options(survey.adjust.domain.lonely=TRUE)
options(survey.lonely.psu="adjust")

# Tabulate anti-HCV status
tab <- svytable(~ antihcv , dfw)
# Convert to proportions (%)
prop_tab <- prop.table(tab) * 100
n_people <- nrow(df_new)
n_poids <- sum(df_new$wc)
# Convert table to data frame and add age and weight info
tab_df <- as.data.frame(prop_tab)
tab_df$age <- x
tab_df$n_poids <- n_poids
  
# Append the results to the final data frame
results_df <- rbind(results_df, tab_df)
}

# Keep only antihcv == 1 (positive)
results_df <- results_df %>% 
  filter(antihcv == 1 )
print(results_df)


library(writexl)

# Save the results_df data frame as an Excel file
write_xlsx(results_df, here("final", "prevalence_final_results_13.xlsx"))

```



#Loop to calculate prevalence by age among people who inject drugs (injvie == 1)
```{r}
# Create empty dataframe for results
results_df <- data.frame(age = numeric(0), serohcv_binary = character(0), proportion = numeric(0), n_poids = numeric(0))

# Loop through each unique, sorted age value
for (x in sort(unique(df$age))) {
   # Subset data for current age and injecting drug use history
  df_new <- df %>%
    filter(age == x, injvie == 1)
  
  # If no data for current age, append zeros and move to next age group
  if (nrow(df_new) == 0) {
    zero_row <- data.frame(age = x, antihcv = "1", Freq = 0, n_poids = 0)
    results_df <- rbind(results_df, zero_row)
    next  # Move to the next age group
  }

  # Define the survey design for the filtered data
  dfw <- svydesign(
id = ~cserv+nqes, strata = ~ville_num, fpc = ~FPC_structure + FPC_UD, weights = ~wc, data = df_new,vce = "linearized",
        nest = TRUE,
        single.unit = "certainty",
        lonely.psu = "adjust"  
  )
  options(survey.adjust.domain.lonely = TRUE)
  options(survey.lonely.psu = "adjust")
  
  # Create a table of proportions for the antihcv variable
  tab <- svytable(~antihcv, dfw)
  prop_tab <- prop.table(tab) * 100
  
  # Convert the table to a data frame
  tab_df <- as.data.frame(prop_tab)
  
  # Add age and total number of people for the current group
  tab_df$age <- x
  tab_df$n_poids <- sum(df_new$wc)
  
  # Append the results to the final data frame
  results_df <- rbind(results_df, tab_df)
}


# Filter the results to keep only antihcv == 1
results_df <- results_df %>%
  filter(antihcv == 1)

# View the results data frame
print(results_df)


```
